description: This is a test module for AWS Secrets Manager integration within the litellm project. It contains various unit tests (using pytest and asyncio) for writing, reading, and managing secrets via the AWSSecretsManagerV2 class, including scenarios with different IAM roles, cross-account access, IRSA, custom STS endpoints, and AWS profile configurations. It also verifies secret metadata, tags, and error handling, serving as a comprehensive test suite for the secret management component.

classes.name: KeyManagementSettings
classes.description: Data class encapsulating AWS key management configuration settings, used for initializing AWSSecretsManagerV2 with specific roles, regions, profiles, and endpoints.

methods.name: check_aws_credentials()
methods.description: Helper function to verify the presence of required AWS environment variables; skips tests if credentials are missing.

methods.name: test_write_and_read_simple_secret()
methods.description: Test for writing and verifying reading a simple secret using AWSSecretsManagerV2.

methods.name: test_write_and_read_json_secret()
methods.description: Test for writing and verifying reading a JSON-formatted secret.

methods.name: test_read_nonexistent_secret()
methods.description: Test attempting to read a secret that does not exist, expecting a None response.

methods.name: test_primary_secret_functionality()
methods.description: Test for storing a primary secret with multiple keys and retrieving specific values.

methods.name: test_write_secret_with_description_and_tags()
methods.description: Test for creating a secret with descriptive metadata and tags, including validation via AWS SDK.

methods.name: test_secret_manager_with_iam_role_settings()
methods.description: Test for instantiating AWSSecretsManagerV2 with specific IAM role settings.

methods.name: test_secret_manager_with_cross_account_settings()
methods.description: Test for initializing with cross-account role configurations.

methods.name: test_secret_manager_with_irsa_settings()
methods.description: Test for IRSA (EKS Service Account Role) configuration setup.

methods.name: test_secret_manager_with_custom_sts_endpoint()
methods.description: Test for using a custom STS endpoint, such as a VPC endpoint.

methods.name: test_secret_manager_with_aws_profile()
methods.description: Test for initializing with an AWS profile.

methods.name: test_load_aws_secret_manager_with_settings()
methods.description: Test loading the secret manager with key management settings, mock environment variables required.

methods.name: test_end_to_end_iam_role_secret_write()
methods.description: Integration test for using IAM assume role to write and read secrets, requires environment setup.
